instruction: I want to ensure my screen never goes to sleep automatically. Can you disable the automatic screen blank feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic screen blank by setting idle-delay to 0. The setup configures idle-delay to 300 seconds, and the task asks the user to set it to 0 (never blank). Evaluator verifies the setting is changed to 0 using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking gsettings idle-delay pattern - setting to 0 disables automatic screen blanking. The uint32 prefix is part of the gsettings output format.
